2608.25927.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
2608.25927.paper_summary: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. These results demonstrate the potential of combining code for persistent world evolution with video models for flexible visual realization, providing a new path toward open-ended world models.
2608.25927.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型旨在模擬複雜環境在行動和事件下的演變，然而現有的基於視頻的世界模型主要從視覺觀察中學習動態，這些觀察揭示了結果，而不是支配世界演變的基本知識、規則和機制。這使得維持持久的後果和支持連貫的開放式演變變得困難。我們介紹了代碼世界模型，這是一個通過結合語言模型的推理和編碼能力與視頻模型的生成先驗，將世界演變與視覺實現分開的框架。一個編碼代理作為世界大腦，推理事件及其後果，並生成可執行的代碼以維持持久的世界狀態並執行符合規則的演變。為了將可執行狀態與視覺生成連接起來，我們引入了一種代理表示，該表示編碼逐幀的時空約束並編譯成代理視頻，這使得視頻模型能夠渲染高保真度的視覺觀察。我們進一步開發數據管道，以從遊戲和現實世界視頻中構建對齊的代理觀察對。在對配對的遊戲數據進行微調後，MiniMax-H3 遵循由編碼代理構建的簡單互動世界中的基於代理的時空規範，同時保留豐富的視覺細節和動態。這些結果展示了將代碼用於持久世界演變與視頻模型用於靈活視覺實現結合的潛力，為開放式世界模型提供了一條新途徑。
